examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
etth'āyaṃ dhammasaddo sakkate dhanvanaṃ-saddena sadiso maruvācako'ti veditabbo, yathā daḷhadhammā'ti-pada

34605.meaning2: who blows, player (of a trumpet, etc.)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasiren'eva catuddisā viññāpeyya, evam'eva kho evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatr'āvatiṭṭhati.

34607.meaning2: filter or water-strainer (often seen as dhammakaraka)

examples.text: tam'enaṃ suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā jātarūpaṃ mūsāyaṃ pakkhipitvā dhamati sandhamati niddhamati.
paṃsukūladharaṃ jantuṃ, kisaṃ dhamanisanthataṃ, ekaṃ vanasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

34614.meaning2: covered, spread with veins; with prominent veins; i.e. emaciated

34615.commentary: (THa) dhamanisanthato'ti dhamanīhi santhatagatto appamaṃsalohitatāya pākaṭīhi kaṇḍarasirāhi vitatasarīro.

examples.text: paṃsukūladharaṃ jantuṃ, kisaṃ dhamanisanthataṃ, ekaṃ vanasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
kālapabb'aṅgasaṅkāso, kiso dhamanisanthato, mattaññū annapānamhi, adīnamanaso naro.

34616.meaning1: with limbs covered in veins; with protuding blood vessels all over
34616.meaning2: having veins showing all over the body (for lack of flesh)

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhante, ārāmena ārāmaṃ, uyyānena uyyānaṃ anucaṅkamāmi anuvicarāmi. so'haṃ tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte, na viya maññe cakkhuṃ bandhante janassa dassanāya.

seyyathā'pi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya adhimatto saddo hoti, evam'eva kho me, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.

34619.meaning2: causes to blow, causes to sound

examples.text: atthi nu kho bhante kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati
gāth'ābhigītaṃ me abhojaneyyaṃ, sampassataṃ brāhmaṇa n'esa dhammo, gāth'ābhigītaṃ panudanti buddhā, dhamme satī brāhmaṇa vutti'r'esā.
aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. katame aṭṭha?
pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca

34628.commentary: (VIN 2.5.1.4) dhammo nāma buddhabhāsito, sāvakabhāsito, isibhāsito, devatābhāsito, atth'ūpasañhito, dhamm'ūpasañhito. (DNa) dhamman'ti suttaṃ.

examples.text: imāni cattāri ariyasaccānī'ti, bhikkhave, mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṃkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī'ti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.

34629.grammar: masc, normally pl dhammā, from dharati

examples.text: yassa loke sakaṃ n'atthi, asatā ca na socati, dhammesu ca na gacchati, sa ve santo'ti vuccatī'ti.
manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati parittacetaso.

34630.grammar: masc, normally pl dhammā, from dharati

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ sukhamanveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.
tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, yatth'assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.

34631.commentary: (SNPa) tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo'ti tathā hi te esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā, yassā suppaṭividdhatā yaṃ yaṃ icchasi, taṃ taṃ jānāsī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: yadā dvayesu dhammesu, pāragū hoti brāhmaṇo, ath'assa sabbe saṃyogā, atthaṃ gacchanti jānato.
atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

34632.meaning1: truth; reality; principle; truth behind the teaching

examples.text: alaṃ, vakkali, kiṃ te iminā pūtikāyena diṭṭhena? yo kho, vakkali, dhammaṃ passati so maṃ passati, yo maṃ passati so dhammaṃ passati
na hi verena verāni, sammant'īdha kudācanaṃ, averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.
yamhi saccañ'ca dhammo ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo, sa ve vantamalo dhīro, thero iti pavuccati.
āratī viratī pāpā, majjapānā ca saṃyamo, appamādo ca dhammesu, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihat'ādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti.

34635.meaning1: of such nature; liable (to); prone (to); destined (for)

examples.text: maraṇadhammo'mhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca, byādhidhammo'mhi, byādhiṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā pāsādasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so pāsādo hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi, dhammo pāsādo.
yathā'pi rahado gambhīro, vippasanno anāvilo, evaṃ dhammāni sutvāna, vippasīdanti paṇḍitā.
yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi
yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti
abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
so ñātidhammo ca ayaṃ nidassito, petāna'pūjā ca katā uḷārā, balañ'ca bhikkhūnam'anuppadinnaṃ, tumhehi puññaṃ pasutaṃ anappakan'ti.

34641.commentary: (MNa) daḷhadhammā dhanuggaho'ti daḷhaṃ dhanuṃ gahetvā ṭhito issāso.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā susikkhitā katahatthā kat'ūpāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu.

34642.meaning1: Dhamma discourse; discussion about the nature of things
34642.commentary: (THa) me dhammakathaṃ suṇantū'ti mayā satthu santike sutaṃ catusaccadhammapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ kathaṃ suṇantu.

examples.text: disā hi me dhammakathaṃ suṇantu, disā hi me yuñjantu buddhasāsane, disā hi me te manujā bhajantu, ye dhammamevādapayanti santo.
tadā sāvatthiyaṃ satta manussakoṭiyo vasanti. tesu satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā pañcakoṭimattā manussā ariyasāvakā jātā, dvekoṭimattā manussā puthujjanā.

tato therā ime amhesu garucittīkāraṃ na karontī'ti navake bhikkhū dvīhi saṅgahehi na saṅgaṇhanti, n'eva dhammasaṅgahena saṅgaṇhanti, na āmisasaṅgahena, cīvarena vā pattena vā pattapariyāpannena vā vasanaṭṭhānena vā kilamante'pi nappaṭijagganti, pāḷiṃ vā aṭṭhakathaṃ vā dhammakathābandhaṃ vā guḷhaganthaṃ vā na sikkhāpenti.
ahaṃ kho'mhi dhammakathiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na dhammakathikā'ti. so tena dhammakathikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti, sīlavā ca, bahussuto ca, dhammakathiko ca, paris'āvacaro ca, visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.

34645.meaning1: fact of being a Dhamma preacher

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi dhammakathiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na dhammakathikā'ti. so tena dhammakathikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
so paṭipadaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ karitvā tena dhammakathikattena n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, sappurisadhammo.

34646.meaning2: monks who supported the primacy of study over practice

34647.meaning1: young deity who preaches the Dhamma

34648.meaningLit: discourse on the question about the Dhamma teacher

34652.meaning2: Chapter 12 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

34653.meaning1: legally valid action; legitimate vinaya procedure
34653.meaning2: legally valid act, procedure in accordance with Vinaya rules

examples.text: dhammakamme vematiko ujjhāpanake khiyyanake āpatti pācittiyassa. dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī ujjhāpanake khiyyanake āpatti pācittiyassa.

34654.meaning1: perceiving as a legally valid action; regarding (something) as a legitimate vinaya procedure

34655.meaning1: perceiving (the act) as a legally valid act; regarding as a legitimate procedure

examples.text: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī ujjhāpanake khiyyanake āpatti pācittiyassa.

34658.meaning1: truth loving; Dhamma lover; (comm) loves the three baskets
34658.commentary: (ANa) dhamme assa kāmo sineho'ti dhammakāmo, tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ piyāyatī'ti attho.

examples.text: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.
puna caparaṃ, subhūti, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo.

34659.commentary: (DNa) tattha dhammakāyo iti'pī'ti kasmā tathāgato dhammakāyo'ti vutto? tathāgato hi tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ hadayena cintetvā vācāya abhinīhari. ten'assa kāyo dhammamayattā dhammo'va. iti dhammo kāyo assā'ti dhammakāyo. dhammakāyattā eva brahmakāyo.

examples.text: tathāgatassa h'etaṃ, vāseṭṭha, adhivacanaṃ dhammakāyo iti'pi, brahmakāyo iti'pi, dhammabhūto iti'pi, brahmabhūto iti'pi.

34660.meaning1: having the teaching as even warmth in the belly; with Dhamma as the belly heat
34660.commentary: (ANa) dhammakucchisam'ātapo'ti dhammo vuccati catutthajjhānasamādhi, kucchi'y'eva sam'ātapo kucchisam'ātapo. sam'ātapo nāma sam'ātapanaṭṭhānaṃ. dhammo kucchisam'ātapo assā'ti dhammakucchisam'ātapo.

examples.text: sati gīvā siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchisam'ātapo, viveko tassa vāladhi.

34661.meaning1: with Dhamma residing in the belly
34661.commentary: (THa) abhiññāsamathānaṃ ādhānabhāvato samathavipassanāsaṅkhāto dhammo kucchisamāvāso etassā'ti dhammakucchisamāvāso.

examples.text: sati gīvā siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchisamāvāso, viveko tassa vāladhi.

34662.commentary: (ANa) atthakusalo'ti aṭṭhakathāya cheko. dhammakusalo'ti pāḷiyaṃ cheko. niruttikusalo'ti niruttivacanesu cheko.

examples.text: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu atthakusalo ca hoti, dhammakusalo ca, byañjanakusalo ca, niruttikusalo ca, pubb'āparakusalo ca. ettāvatā kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, suggahitaggāhī ca, bahuñ'ca gaṇhāti, gahitañ'c'assa nappamussatī'ti.

34663.commentary: (DNa) dhammaddhajo dhammaketū'ti taṃ dhammaṃ dhajam'iva purakkhatvā ketum'iva ca ukkhipitvā pavattiyā dhammaddhajo dhammaketu ca hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.

iti pūraṇo kassapo sāvakānaṃ na sakkato na garukato na mānito na pūjito, na ca pana pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ sāvakā sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanti. akkuṭṭho ca pana pūraṇo kassapo dhamm'akkosenā'ti.

34665.meaning1: portion of the teaching; division of the Dhamma

examples.text: katame pañca dhammā sacchikātabbā? pañca dhammakkhandhā, sīlakkhandho, samādhikkhandho, paññākkhandho, vimuttikkhandho, vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandho. ime pañca dhammā sacchikātabbā.

34666.meaning1: preaching of the Dhamma; exposition of the teaching
34666.commentary: (MNt) dān'ādīnañ'c'eva appicchat'ādīnañ'ca saṃsāranibbānesu ādīnavānisaṃsānañ'ca vibhāvanavasena sattānaṃ bodhittaye patiṭṭhāpanaparipācanavasena ca pavattā kathā dhamm'akkhānaṃ

examples.text: anāgatam'pi addhānaṃ evarūpo uḷāro satthā bhavissati, evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ dhamm'akkhānaṃ, evarūpā uḷārā vises'ādhigamā paññāyissantī'ti.
etassa bhagavā kālo'ti etassa dhamm'akkhānassa, catunnaṃ vā puggalānaṃ vibhajanassa kālo.

34667.meaning2: block of justice; i.e. of execution

examples.text: ekadivasaṃ mama parisāya vāro pāpuṇātu, ekadivasaṃ tava parisāya, vārappatto migo gantvā dhammagaṇḍikāya gīvaṃ ṭhapetvā nipajjatu, evaṃ sante migā kilantā na bhavissantī'ti.

34668.meaning1: immersed in the teaching; focused on the Dhamma

examples.text: suppabuddhaṃ pabujjhanti, sadā gotamasāvakā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, niccaṃ dhammagatā sati.

34669.meaning1: blaming the Dhamma; finding fault with the teaching
34669.commentary: (VINa) na mayaṃ, bhante ānanda, buddhagarahino'ti bhante ānanda, mayaṃ na buddhaṃ garahāma, na buddhassa dosaṃ dema. na dhammagarahino, na saṅghagarahino.

34670.meaning1: with respect for the teaching; giving weight to the Dhamma

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi, yāthāvadassīhi jit'indriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

34672.meaning1: respect for the Dhamma; reverence towards the teaching
34672.meaning2: respect for the Dhamma; reverence towards the teaching

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, navakena bhikkhunā uddisantena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, uccatare vā dhammagāravena, therena bhikkhunā uddisāpentena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, nīcatare vā dhammagāravenā'ti.

34673.meaning1: respectful towards the teaching; giving weight to the Dhamma

examples.text: tathā hi pana tvaṃ, bho'ti, pādukā ārohitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ oguṇṭhitvā etadavoca, bhaṇa, samaṇa, dhamman'ti. dhammagaruno hi te bhavanto dhammagāravā'ti.

34674.meaning1: fact of having respect for the teaching; fact of giving weight to the Dhamma

examples.text: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.

34675.meaning1: guarded by the Dhamma; protected by the teaching

examples.text: abalaṃ taṃ balaṃ āhu, yassa bālabalaṃ balaṃ, balassa dhammaguttassa, paṭivattā na vijjati.
hito bahunnaṃ paṭipajja bhoge, taṃ devatā rakkhati dhammaguttaṃ, bahussutaṃ sīlavat'ūpapannaṃ, dhamme ṭhitaṃ na vijahati kitti.

34676.meaning2: who announces about the preaching of the Dhamma

examples.text: ujuko nāma so maggo, abhayā nāma sā disā, ratho akūjano nāma, dhammacakkehi saṃyuto.

34678.meaning1: rolling the wheel of Dhamma forward; turning the wheel of the teaching
34678.commentary: (BVa) tattha pañcavaggiyānaṃ attano buddhabhāvaṃ pakāsetvā paññattavarabuddh'āsanagato pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantetvā dhammacakkappavattana-sutt'antaṃ desesi.

examples.text: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi. vipassissa, mārisā, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi evaṃ pabbajjā evaṃ padhānaṃ evaṃ abhisambodhi evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ.

34679.meaningLit: discourse on rolling the wheel of Dhamma forward

34680.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Saccasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
34680.meaningLit: section on rolling the wheel of Dhamma forward

34681.meaning1: insight into the nature of reality; spiritual insight; understanding of the way things are
34681.commentary: (DNa) dhammacakkhun'ti dhammesu vā cakkhuṃ, dhammamayaṃ vā cakkhuṃ, aññesu ṭhānesu tiṇṇaṃ maggānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. idha pana sotāpattimaggass'eva.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti

khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.

34682.meaning1: acquiring insight into the nature of reality; gaining spiritual insight

examples.text: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā. evaṃ mah'atthiyo kho, bhikkhave, dhamm'ābhisamayo, evaṃ mah'atthiyo dhammacakkhupaṭilābho'ti.

34684.meaning1: conduct in line with the Dhamma; ethical conduct; moral behaviour
34684.commentary: (KHPa) dhammassa cariyā, dhammā vā anapetā cariyā dhammacariyā. ñāyante amhākaṃ ime'ti ñātakā.

examples.text: dānañ'ca dhammacariyā ca, ñātakānañ'ca saṅgaho, anavajjāni kammāni, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
ime ca, mahāli, dasa dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha adhammacariyāvisamacariyā'ti vā dhammacariyāsamacariyā'ti vā.

34685.meaning1: taking extreme pleasure in ethical conduct; very fond of conduct in line with the Dhamma

examples.text: pubbaṅ'gamo sucaritesu ahu, dhammesu dhammacariy'ābhirato, anvāyiko bahujanassa ahu, saggesu vedayittha puññaphalaṃ.

34686.meaning1: ethical and moral conduct; good conduct and wholesome behaviour

examples.text: tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti, tividhaṃ manasā dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti.

yo hi, bho sāriputta, mātāpitūnaṃ hetu adhammacārī visamacārī assa, na taṃ seyyo, yo ca kho, bho sāriputta, mātāpitūnaṃ hetu dhammacārī samacārī assa, tadev'ettha seyyo. adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhi, bho sāriputta, dhammacariyāsamacariyā seyyo'ti.

34687.meaning1: because of ethical and moral conduct; due to good conduct and wholesome behaviour

examples.text: dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti.

34688.meaning1: generosity with the teaching; Dhamma sharing

examples.text: katame dve? āmisacāgo ca dhammacāgo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve cāgā.

34689.meaning1: who lives the Dhamma; who practices the teaching; who walks in truth

examples.text: uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyya, dhammaṃ sucaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati. es'ānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.

ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

34692.meaning1: thinking about the Dhamma; examination of phenomena

examples.text: sati gīvā siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchisamāvāso, viveko tassa vāladhi.

34694.meaning1: lawfully accused; properly charged; legally impeached

examples.text: dhammacuditassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno imehi pañcah'ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.

34695.meaning1: monument to the Dhamma; tribute to the teaching
34695.commentary: (MNa) dhammacetiyānī'ti dhammassa cittīkāravacanāni. tīsu hi ratanesu yattha katthaci cittīkāre kate sabbattha kato'y'eva hoti, tasmā bhagavati cittīkāre kate dhammo'pi kato'va hotī'ti bhagavā dhammacetiyānī'ti āha.

examples.text: eso, bhikkhave, rājā pasenadi kosalo dhammacetiyāni bhāsitvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkanto. uggaṇhatha, bhikkhave, dhammacetiyāni, pariyāpuṇātha, bhikkhave, dhammacetiyāni, dhāretha, bhikkhave, dhammacetiyāni.

34696.meaningLit: discourse on monuments to the Dhamma

34697.meaning1: lawful accuser; who charges correctly; who impeaches legally
34697.meaning2: (a monk) who accuses (someone) of an offence properly, by the rules
34697.commentary: (VINa) pañcadasasu dhammesu appatiṭṭhahitvā abhūtena vatthunā codento adhammacodako nāma, tena tathā codito adhammacuditako nāma. vipariyāyena dhammacodakacuditakā veditabbā.

examples.text: dhammacodakassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno imehi pañcah'ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.

34698.meaning1: interest in mental phenomena; desire for thoughts
34698.commentary: (ADHa) dhammacchando'ti sabhāvacchando. ayañ'hi chando nāma taṇhāchando, diṭṭhichando, vīriyachando, dhammacchando'ti bahuvidho nānappakārako. tesu dhammacchando'ti imasmiṃ ṭhāne kattukamyatākusaladhammacchando adhippeto.

examples.text: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.

34699.meaning1: born from Dhamma; born of the teaching

examples.text: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.
